leakage_guard: S(t), velocity, and acceleration features use only anchors <= t.
Transition models use only completed pairs s+h<t.
Decoders use only geometry anchors a<t.
Oracle phase/selected decoders use actual S(t+h) and are diagnostic only.

models.phase_only_ridge_flow_decoder: Predict future NINO/SOI phase only, then decode.
models.phase_energy_ridge_flow_decoder: Predict phase plus NINO energy/rung and coupling-energy context, then decode.
models.selected_ridge_flow_decoder: Predict the broader ablation-selected future geometry target set, then decode.
models.selected_analog_flow_decoder: Analog transition over selected future targets using current geometry plus velocity/acceleration neighbors.
models.selected_direct_geometry_control: Control: current selected geometry/velocity directly regresses future raw value delta.
models.oracle_phase_only_decoder: Diagnostic only: decode actual future phase fields.
models.oracle_selected_decoder: Diagnostic only: decode actual future selected geometry fields.
